expected_outcome: Reject (v1 hand review): This Evelyn list is a cEDH reanimator/Thoracle build (Entomb, Unmarked Grave, Animate Dead, Necromancy, Worldgorger Dragon). Reanimate is a 1-mana piece of that core. Cordial Vampire is one more Vampire trigger for Evelyn but a 2-mana +1/+1-counter body that does not advance any win line: a power downgrade at this ceiling despite its synergy.
